---
title: "JOINT粗细网格联合：固定收缩比例与资金效果"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  cache: false
  freeze: false
  error: false
params:
  project_root: null
  parent: null
  parent_sha256: null
  study: null

  depth_sha256: null

---

固定同一784期、原JOINT票据与累计筛弱留现金基准；每期1024元上限、2元票、10万元本金。
北单实际回款已含一次0.65，赛前估价不使用结算SP。本轮是暴露历史诊断，不是未见验证。

保留35格的购买单元，将其已冻结回款/投入预测按0%、25%、50%、75%、100%向对应9格预测收缩。
0%和100%分别要求对应组件有支持；中间比例要求两个组件均有支持，否则UNKNOWN、不调整。
这是粗细网格之间的比例，原模型内部50%累计＋50%近20期保持不变。
固定BAD<0.8、GOOD>=1.2，不搜索阈值；每个目标期使用其原生cutoff封存预测，不重拟合。
原模型历史标签可用时间仍为最后比赛截止＋48小时代理，只能用于研究。

执行两种相同规则的局部对照：ADD仅对好细格原保留票增购最多50%；BOTH同时对差细格减半。
增购按概率排序、最多两份，所有方案不超过预算，余款留现金。35格单元始终不变，100%也是粗信号投射到细格。
这隔离收缩本身的效果，并非完整的网格配额轮动：没有引入不同的新候选组，也没有扩大独立覆盖。
每个方案配相同逐期实际投入的纯概率对照。模型和选票冻结后才读取当期结算。

```{r}
library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(readr);library(ggplot2)
source(file.path(params$project_root,'r/joint_tail_risk.R'))
source(file.path(params$project_root,'r/joint_win_scale.R'))
source(file.path(params$project_root,'r/joint_grid_shrink.R'))
source(file.path(params$project_root,'r/joint_grid_stability.R'))
source(file.path(params$project_root,'r/diagnostic_verified_csv.R'))
source(file.path(params$project_root,'r/fundamentals_equity_curves.R'))
stopifnot(!dir.exists(params$output))
check<-system2(params$python,c(shQuote(file.path(params$project_root,'scripts/check_persistent_data_layout.py')),
 '--contract',shQuote(file.path(params$project_root,'config/persistent_data_layout.json'))),stdout=TRUE)
stopifnot(is.null(attr(check,'status')))
loaded<-list()
for(name in c('parent','depth')) {
 path<-if(name=='parent')file.path(params$parent,'receipt.json') else file.path(params$depth_report,'receipt.json')
 sha<-if(name=='parent')params$parent_sha256 else params$depth_sha256
 raw<-readBin(path,'raw',n=file.info(path)$size)
 stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==sha)
 loaded[[name]]<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE)
}
parent<-loaded$parent;depth<-loaded$depth
stopifnot(parent$status=='PASS',identical(parent$historical_admission,FALSE))
for(k in names(parent$code))stopifnot(digest::digest(file=file.path(params$project_root,k),algo='sha256')==parent$code[[k]])
objects<-list()
for(k in c('plans-receipt.json')) {
 raw<-readBin(file.path(params$parent,k),'raw',n=file.info(file.path(params$parent,k))$size)
 stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==parent$files[[k]])
 objects[[k]]<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE)
}
stopifnot(params$depth_sha256==objects[['plans-receipt.json']]$source_hashes$depth)
raw<-readBin(params$metadata,'raw',n=file.info(params$metadata)$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==params$metadata_sha256)
metadata<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE)
stopifnot(metadata$parent_sha256==params$parent_sha256,metadata$contexts_sha256==parent$files[['contexts.json']],identical(metadata$code[sort(names(metadata$code))],parent$code[sort(names(parent$code))]))
reticulate::use_python(params$python,required=TRUE)
reader<-reticulate::import('src.strategy_diagnostic_inputs',convert=TRUE)
core<-reticulate::import('src.temporal_learning.core',convert=FALSE)
provenance<-reticulate::import('src.temporal_learning.provenance',convert=TRUE)
pyroot<-reticulate::import('pathlib',convert=FALSE)$Path(params$project_root)
closures<-list();cuts<-list()
for(r in metadata$receipts) {
 id<-r$target_issue
 native<-core$Cutoff$decision_epoch(id,r$cutoff_ts)
 stopifnot(reticulate::py_to_r(native$identity)==r$cutoff_identity,identical(r$historical_admission,FALSE))
 if(!is.null(r$implementation))closures[[r$implementation$closure_sha256]]<-r$implementation
 cuts[[id]]<-list(cutoff_kind=r$cutoff_kind,cutoff_identity=r$cutoff_identity,
  cutoff_ts=r$cutoff_ts,target_issue=id,historical_admission=FALSE,model_receipt_sha256=params$parent_sha256)
}
for(c in closures)provenance$verify_implementation_closure(pyroot,c)
raw<-readBin(file.path(params$grid_model,'receipt.json'),'raw',n=file.info(file.path(params$grid_model,'receipt.json'))$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==params$grid_sha256)
grid_model<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE)
stopifnot(grid_model$status=='PASS',identical(grid_model$historical_admission,FALSE),grid_model$parent_sha256==params$parent_sha256)
for(k in names(grid_model$code))stopifnot(digest::digest(file=file.path(params$project_root,k),algo='sha256')==grid_model$code[[k]])
raw<-readBin(file.path(params$grid_model,'forecasts-receipt.json'),'raw',n=file.info(file.path(params$grid_model,'forecasts-receipt.json'))$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==grid_model$files[['forecasts-receipt.json']])
grid_receipt<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE)
provenance$verify_implementation_closure(pyroot,grid_receipt$implementation)
stopifnot(grid_receipt$source_hashes$frozen==objects[['plans-receipt.json']]$source_hashes$frozen,
 grid_receipt$source_hashes$depth==params$depth_sha256,grid_receipt$parameters$alpha==.5,grid_receipt$parameters$window==20)
for(id in names(cuts))cuts[[id]]$model_receipt_sha256<-params$grid_sha256

objects[['contexts.json']]<-NULL
frpath<-file.path(params$study,'plans-frozen.json');raw<-readBin(frpath,'raw',n=file.info(frpath)$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==objects[['plans-receipt.json']]$source_hashes$frozen)
fr<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE)
tables<-list();seen<-character()
for(path in names(fr$receipt$plan_hashes)) {
 b<-jsonlite::fromJSON(reader$read_verified_bundle_json(path,fr$receipt$plan_hashes[[path]]))
 stopifnot(!b$issue %in% seen,b$issue %in% names(cuts));seen<-c(seen,b$issue)
 if(length(b$plans$P0_OPEN$tickets))tables[[b$issue]]<-as_tibble(b$plans$P0_OPEN$tickets) |> mutate(issue=b$issue)
}
stopifnot(setequal(seen,names(cuts)))
x<-bind_rows(tables) |> mutate(ticket_id=paste(sleeve_id,ticket_col_idx,sep=':'),
 cell=paste(cut(prob,c(0,.001,.002,.003,.005,.01,.02,1),right=FALSE,include.lowest=TRUE),
 cut(payout_hat,c(0,128,256,512,1024,Inf),right=FALSE),sep=' | '))
base<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$parent,'frozen-plans.csv'),parent$files[['frozen-plans.csv']],cols(issue='c',ticket_id='c')) |>
 filter(policy=='long_cash_only') |> select(issue,ticket_id,base_copies=copies,cutoff_identity)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(base[c('issue','ticket_id')]),nrow(base)==nrow(x))
x<-x |> left_join(base,by=c('issue','ticket_id'),relationship='one-to-one')
stopifnot(!anyNA(x$base_copies),all(x$base_copies %in% c(0L,1L)))
f0<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$grid_model,'forecasts.csv'),grid_model$files[['forecasts.csv']],cols(issue='c'))
# Construct exact nested mapping from label-free ticket coordinates, never rounded cut labels.
geometry<-x |> mutate(coarse_cell=paste('COARSE9',
 cut(prob,c(0,.002,.005,1),right=FALSE,include.lowest=TRUE),
 cut(payout_hat,c(0,256,1024,Inf),right=FALSE),sep=' | ')) |> distinct(cell,coarse_cell)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(geometry$cell),!anyNA(geometry))
fine<-f0 |> filter(startsWith(cell,'FINE35 | ')) |>
 transmute(issue,cell=substring(cell,10),fine_score=return_ratio,fine_ready=supported & long_hit_signal!='UNKNOWN',cutoff_identity)
coarse<-f0 |> filter(startsWith(cell,'COARSE9 | ')) |>
 transmute(issue,coarse_cell=cell,coarse_score=return_ratio,coarse_ready=supported & long_hit_signal!='UNKNOWN',coarse_cutoff=cutoff_identity)
f<-expand_grid(issue=names(cuts),cell=geometry$cell) |>
 left_join(geometry,by='cell',relationship='many-to-one') |>
 left_join(fine,by=c('issue','cell'),relationship='one-to-one') |>
 left_join(coarse,by=c('issue','coarse_cell'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(fine_ready=replace_na(fine_ready,FALSE),coarse_ready=replace_na(coarse_ready,FALSE))
# Available component identities must equal the native target identity; absent warm-up stays unsupported.
for(id in names(cuts)) {
 ix<-which(f$issue==id);c<-cuts[[id]]$cutoff_identity
 stopifnot(all(is.na(f$cutoff_identity[ix]) | f$cutoff_identity[ix]==c),all(is.na(f$coarse_cutoff[ix]) | f$coarse_cutoff[ix]==c))
 f$cutoff_identity[ix]<-c
}
order<-sort(names(cuts));map<-tibble(issue=order,period=seq_along(order))
stopifnot(objects[['plans-receipt.json']]$parameters$alpha==.5,
 objects[['plans-receipt.json']]$parameters$window==20)
code_files<-c('r/joint_grid_shrink.R','r/joint_grid_stability.R','r/joint_win_scale.R','r/joint_tail_risk.R','r/diagnostic_verified_csv.R',
 'r/fundamentals_equity_curves.R','quarto/215_joint_grid_shrink.qmd')
code<-setNames(as.list(vapply(file.path(params$project_root,code_files),digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),code_files)
import_closure<-provenance$implementation_closure(pyroot,list('src.strategy_diagnostic_inputs','src.temporal_learning.core'),distributions=list('numpy','pandas'))
```

```{r}
config<-expand_grid(lambda=c(0,.25,.5,.75,1),mode=c('ADD','BOTH')) |> mutate(channel='BLEND',policy=paste0('L',100*lambda,'_',mode))
xs<-split(x,x$issue);fs<-split(f,f$issue);plans<-list();states<-list()
for(id in order) {
 t<-if(id %in% names(xs))xs[[id]] else x[FALSE,]
 raw_signal<-if(id %in% names(fs))fs[[id]] else f[FALSE,]
 cut<-cuts[[id]];stopifnot(all(t$cutoff_identity==cut$cutoff_identity))
 attr(raw_signal,'input_receipt')<-list(cutoff=cut,hash=digest::digest(raw_signal,algo='sha256'))
 for(i in seq_len(nrow(config))) {
  channel<-config$channel[i];mode<-config$mode[i];policy<-config$policy[i]
  s<-joint_grid_shrink(raw_signal,cut,params$grid_sha256,config$lambda[i])
  # Independent mixture arithmetic before independent allocation replay.
  ready<-if(config$lambda[i]==0)raw_signal$fine_ready else if(config$lambda[i]==1)raw_signal$coarse_ready else raw_signal$fine_ready & raw_signal$coarse_ready
  expected<-if(config$lambda[i]==0)raw_signal$fine_score else if(config$lambda[i]==1)raw_signal$coarse_score else (1-config$lambda[i])*raw_signal$fine_score+config$lambda[i]*raw_signal$coarse_score
  stopifnot(identical(s$supported,ready),isTRUE(all.equal(s$return_ratio[ready],expected[ready])))
  a<-joint_win_scale(t,s,cut,params$grid_sha256,channel,mode,.5,.8,1.2,.5,.5,2,1024)
  # Independent vectorized replay, separate from allocator's per-cell loops.
  replay<-t |> filter(base_copies==1L) |>
   left_join(s |> select(cell,return_ratio,long_return_ratio,supported,long_hit_signal),by='cell',relationship='many-to-one') |>
   mutate(score=if(channel=='BLEND')return_ratio else 2*return_ratio-long_return_ratio,
    ready=!is.na(supported) & supported & !is.na(long_hit_signal) & long_hit_signal!='UNKNOWN',
    bad=ready & score<.8,good=ready & score>=1.2) |> arrange(desc(prob),ticket_id) |>
   group_by(cell) |> mutate(copies=as.integer(!(mode %in% c('CUT','BOTH') & bad & row_number()>n()-floor(n()*.5))),
    extra=mode %in% c('ADD','BOTH') & good & row_number()<=floor(n()*.5)) |> ungroup()
  extra_rows<-replay |> filter(extra) |> arrange(desc(prob),ticket_id) |> slice_head(n=512L-sum(replay$copies))
  replay<-replay |> mutate(copies=copies+as.integer(ticket_id %in% .env$extra_rows$ticket_id))
  independent<-integer(nrow(t));independent[match(replay$ticket_id,t$ticket_id)]<-replay$copies
  stopifnot(identical(independent,a$copies))
  changed<-t;changed$actual_gross<-seq_len(nrow(t))*1e9
  stopifnot(identical(a,joint_win_scale(changed,s,cut,params$grid_sha256,channel,mode,.5,.8,1.2,.5,.5,2,1024)))
  plans[[paste(id,policy)]]<-a |> select(ticket_id,copies) |> mutate(issue=id,policy=policy,cutoff_identity=cut$cutoff_identity)
  if(mode=='ADD')states[[paste(id,config$lambda[i])]]<-s |> transmute(issue,channel=paste0('L',100*config$lambda[i]),cell,score=return_ratio,state=if_else(!supported,'UNKNOWN',if_else(score<.8,'BAD',if_else(score>=1.2,'GOOD','NEUTRAL'))))
  # Same stake in every issue; a diagnostic comparator, not outcome-selected.
  ids<-which(t$base_copies==1L);ids<-ids[order(-t$prob[ids],t$ticket_id[ids])]
  count<-sum(a$copies);matched<-integer(nrow(t))
  if(count<=length(ids))matched[head(ids,count)]<-1L else {
   matched[ids]<-1L;matched[head(ids,count-length(ids))]<-2L
  }
  stopifnot(sum(matched)==count,all(matched<=2L),all(matched[t$base_copies==0L]==0L))
  plans[[paste(id,policy,'PROB')]]<-tibble(ticket_id=t$ticket_id,copies=matched,issue=id,policy=paste0(policy,'_PROB'),cutoff_identity=cut$cutoff_identity)
 }
 if(match(id,order)%%100==0)message('Frozen/replayed ',match(id,order),' issues')
}
p<-bind_rows(plans);state<-bind_rows(states);out<-params$output;dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
write_csv(p,file.path(out,'frozen-plans.csv'));write_csv(state,file.path(out,'frozen-states.csv'))
stopifnot(identical(code,setNames(as.list(vapply(file.path(params$project_root,code_files),digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),code_files)))
jsonlite::write_json(list(historical_admission=FALSE,imported_model_receipt=params$grid_sha256,
 sources=list(original_freeze=objects[['plans-receipt.json']]$source_hashes$frozen,original_tickets=fr$receipt$plan_hashes,
 forecasts=grid_model$files[['forecasts.csv']],grid_forecast_receipt=grid_model$files[['forecasts-receipt.json']],upstream_contexts=grid_receipt$contexts_sha256,upstream_strata=grid_receipt$strata_sha256,base_plans=parent$files[['frozen-plans.csv']],metadata=params$metadata_sha256,depth=params$depth_sha256),
 cutoffs=cuts,new_import_implementation=import_closure,code=code,
 parameters=list(coarse_weights=unique(config$lambda),alpha=.5,window=20,bad=.8,good=1.2,cut_fraction=.5,add_fraction=.5,unit_cny=2,budget_cny=1024,initial_capital_cny=100000),
 independent_replays=length(order)*nrow(config),plans_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(out,'frozen-plans.csv'),algo='sha256'),
 states_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(out,'frozen-states.csv'),algo='sha256')),
 file.path(out,'plans-receipt.json'),pretty=TRUE,auto_unbox=TRUE,digits=NA)
```

以下才读取结算，逐期对账。ROI分母为实际投入；最大回撤按各窗口起点重新计算。

```{r}
g<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$depth_report,'groups.csv'),depth$outputs[['groups.csv']],cols(issue='c')) |>
 filter(arm=='JOINT') |> select(issue,sleeve_id,actual_rank,actual_gross_cny)
z<-x |> left_join(g,by=c('issue','sleeve_id'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(hit=prob_rank==actual_rank,gross=if_else(hit,actual_gross_cny,0))
stopifnot(!anyNA(z$hit))
labels<-z |> select(issue,ticket_id,hit,gross)
r<-p |> left_join(labels,by=c('issue','ticket_id'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 group_by(issue,policy) |> summarise(stake=sum(2*copies),gross=sum(gross*copies),hits=sum(hit*copies),.groups='drop')
r<-expand_grid(issue=order,policy=c(config$policy,paste0(config$policy,'_PROB'))) |> left_join(r,by=c('issue','policy')) |>
 mutate(across(c(stake,gross,hits),~replace_na(.x,0)))
old<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$parent,'rows.csv'),parent$files[['rows.csv']],cols(issue='c')) |>
 filter(policy %in% c('P0_OPEN','long_cash_only'))
rebuilt<-z |> group_by(issue) |> summarise(stake=sum(2*base_copies),gross=sum(gross*base_copies),hits=sum(hit*base_copies),.groups='drop') |>
 left_join(old |> filter(policy=='long_cash_only'),by='issue',suffix=c('_new','_old'),relationship='one-to-one')
stopifnot(all(abs(rebuilt$gross_new-rebuilt$gross_old)<1e-6),all(rebuilt$stake_new==rebuilt$stake_old),all(rebuilt$hits_new==rebuilt$hits_old))
rows<-bind_rows(old |> select(issue,policy,stake,gross,hits),r) |> mutate(net=gross-stake,budget_cny=1024,cash_cny=1024-stake,
 status=if_else(stake>0,'COMPLETE','NO_BET'),model='frozen-market') |> left_join(map,by='issue',relationship='many-to-one')
curves<-strategy_equity_curves(rows |> select(-period),order,100000);stopifnot(!any(curves$stopped))
windows<-tribble(~window,~start,~end,'ALL',1L,784L,'PRE700',1L,699L,'TAIL700',700L,784L,'CLIFF671',671L,685L,'TAIL_DROP716',716L,771L)
summary<-joint_tail_windows(rows,windows)
bridge<-p |> left_join(z |> select(issue,ticket_id,base_copies,gross),by=c('issue','ticket_id'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(delta=copies-base_copies) |> filter(delta!=0) |> left_join(map,by='issue',relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(scope=if_else(period>=700,'TAIL700','PRE700'),action=if_else(delta>0,'ADD','CUT')) |> group_by(policy,scope,action) |>
 summarise(stake_change=sum(2*delta),gross_change=sum(gross*delta),net_change=gross_change-stake_change,.groups='drop')
assessment<-z |> filter(base_copies==1L) |>
 inner_join(state,by=c('issue','cell'),relationship='many-to-many') |> left_join(map,by='issue',relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(scope=if_else(period>=700,'TAIL700','PRE700')) |> group_by(channel,scope,state) |>
 summarise(issues=n_distinct(issue),cells=n_distinct(paste(issue,cell)),tickets=n(),expected=sum(prob),hits=sum(hit),stake=2*n(),gross=sum(gross),.groups='drop') |>
 mutate(net=gross-stake,roi=net/stake,hit_ratio=hits/expected)
incremental<-rows |> filter(policy %in% config$policy) |>
 left_join(rows |> filter(policy=='long_cash_only') |> select(issue,base_net=net),by='issue',relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(incremental_net=net-base_net)
concentration<-incremental |> group_by(policy) |> arrange(desc(incremental_net),.by_group=TRUE) |>
 summarise(net_gain=sum(incremental_net),positive_issues=sum(incremental_net>1e-7),negative_issues=sum(incremental_net< -1e-7),
 largest_increment=max(incremental_net),without_top1=sum(incremental_net)-sum(head(pmax(incremental_net,0),1)),
 without_top3=sum(incremental_net)-sum(head(pmax(incremental_net,0),3)),.groups='drop')
correlation<-rows |> select(issue,policy,net) |> pivot_wider(names_from=policy,values_from=net) |> select(-issue) |> cor()
for(n in c('rows','curves','summary','bridge','assessment','incremental','concentration'))write_csv(get(n),file.path(out,paste0(n,'.csv')))
write_csv(as_tibble(correlation,rownames='policy'),file.path(out,'correlations.csv'))
history<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$grid_model,'grid-history.csv'),grid_model$files[['grid-history.csv']],cols(issue_code='c')) |>
 filter(grid=='FINE35') |> mutate(cell=substring(cell,10)) |> select(-grid) |> rename(issue=issue_code)
signal_assessment<-state |> inner_join(history,by=c('issue','cell'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 left_join(map,by='issue',relationship='many-to-one') |> rename(grid=channel)
stability<-joint_grid_stability(signal_assessment,tribble(~window,~start,~end,'ALL',1L,784L,'MATURE',101L,784L,'TAIL700',700L,784L))
write_csv(stability$summary,file.path(out,'stability.csv'));write_csv(stability$states,file.path(out,'signal-states.csv'))
knitr::kable(stability$summary,digits=3)
knitr::kable(summary |> mutate(roi=100*roi) |> rename(ROI_percent=roi),digits=2)
knitr::kable(bridge,digits=2)
knitr::kable(assessment,digits=3)
knitr::kable(concentration,digits=2)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
tail<-main |> filter(period>=700) |> group_by(policy) |>
 mutate(relative_net=cumsum(net),local_drawdown=cummax(c(0,relative_net))[-1]-relative_net) |> ungroup()
plot2<-tail |> select(policy,period,relative_net,local_drawdown) |>
 pivot_longer(c(relative_net,local_drawdown),names_to='metric',values_to='CNY') |>
 ggplot(aes(period,CNY,colour=policy))+geom_line(linewidth=.7)+facet_wrap(~metric,ncol=1,scales='free_y')+
 geom_vline(xintercept=c(716,771),linetype=3,colour='grey60')+
 theme_minimal()+theme(legend.position='bottom')+labs(title='Issues 700 onward: local net and drawdown',x='Issue index',colour=NULL)
ggsave(file.path(out,'tail-curves.png'),plot2,width=12,height=8,dpi=150);plot2
```

不能以回撤下降单独判优，必须同时检查投入、净收益、ROI、期命中和同投入PROB对照。
ADD在相同票上加倍不会增加独立覆盖，BOTH可能因删除票而丢失命中期；同场与同组重叠不能当独立样本。
本轮不以事后最优窗口选择策略，没有验证集调参或未来有效性承诺。


```{r, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
p3<-stability$states |> filter(window %in% c('MATURE','TAIL700'),state!='UNKNOWN') |>
 ggplot(aes(state,100*roi,fill=grid))+geom_col(position='dodge')+geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
 facet_wrap(~window)+theme_minimal()+theme(legend.position='bottom')+
 labs(title='Fine cells with increasing coarse shrinkage: forward ROI',x='Prior signal',y='ROI (%)',fill=NULL)
ggsave(file.path(out,'signal-roi.png'),p3,width=11,height=7,dpi=150);p3
```

结果同时列示ADD、BOTH和逐期同投入PROB对照。100%不是原9格配置重跑，而是相同35格分配单元上的粗预测。
新模型由父模型完整逐cutoff上下文、权重账本及代码闭包间接绑定；旧metadata仅提供已核验的原票决策时点身份。
未重新拟合、未根据结果选择部署权重。目标标签扰动不变性由父模型原生验证与本轮下游选票重放共同覆盖。

本轮收敛结论：固定比例向粗格收缩没有改善资金效果。ADD中，0%净收益68648元、ROI9.50%、最大回撤28270元；
25%为65355元、9.09%、28372元；50%为56239元、7.88%、30237元；75%为60486元、8.55%、28480元；
100%为58922元、8.40%、30186元。所有收缩档的净收益低于0%，最大回撤高于0%。
相比不进行本轮加减仓的基准61422元、9.35%、22224元，0%加仓虽增收益，也增加回撤；不能宣称它全面更优。

预热后细格信号翻转率为8.58%，25%和50%收缩分别变为10.15%和9.49%；75%为8.99%，100%为7.98%。
极端GOOD/BAD翻转减少，但固定阈值附近的普通切换未必减少。35格支持资金占比已接近98%，
这次粗格信息不能有效弥补细格稀疏，反而削弱强弱区分：50%混合时GOOD随后ROI8.39%，BAD随后ROI20.41%。

BOTH全部低于原基准净收益，且最大回撤均高于原基准；不能用其局部少亏证明全程减仓有效。
700期后0%ADD净收益14445元、回撤8703元，各收缩ADD档净收益也均低于它。
所有ADD仍命中332期，671–685期仍全部未中。这是原票复制的结构性限制，不是网格收缩能够补救的。
0%ADD相对基准增加7226元，但扣除贡献最大的3期增量后为负6763元，增益存在明显集中性。
因此保留35格作为细分诊断，不引入此次固定粗格收缩，也不把“曲线更平滑”当作资金信号升级。
